source_fixture_boundary.literature_provenance_limit: The four-way frame clone and its invariance gate are campaign/Explorer constructions already frozen in the candidate artifact, not direct paper evidence. This packet only instantiates their exact test fixture.
source_fixture_boundary.claim_boundary: These fixture constants make the already-defined Stage-A contract executable before code. They are not literature-derived findings, do not change the candidate mechanism, and cannot support an empirical or formal-project claim.

frozen_trace_language.trace_isolation: Each T01-T16 row runs in an independent empty registry namespace. The frame branches inside T16 are isolated counterfactual representations of one logical record and are never co-registered.
frozen_trace_language.initial_state_snapshot_rule: Each row's initial_escrow_state is the snapshot immediately after its order-1 DECISION_REGISTERED receipt has created the immutable record and before any primitive execution; order 1 remains in ordered_receipts so the complete ledger is frozen.
frozen_trace_language.receipt_order_rule: ordered_receipts is the exact ingestion-and-emission ledger order. Physical cause selection uses physical_event_time, cause precedence and event_uuid, never arrival order.
frozen_trace_language.unchanged_state_rule: An input receipt whose order is not separately named in expected_state_transitions leaves the state class unchanged and performs only its declared append-only effect. A declared output receipt is emitted atomically by the preceding compare-and-set and causes no additional state transition.
frozen_trace_language.reward_ownership_rule: A unique external team-reward event is owned once by this decision only when its physical event time lies in [tau,T), or it is explicitly declared as this decision's terminal impulse at T. Shared team reward does not assert focal-agent retrospective responsibility.
frozen_trace_language.release_rule: Only the watermark compare-and-set may emit a learning release. release_count is the count for the logical decision_id, not a delivery or frame count.
frozen_trace_language.symbolic_target_rule: Stage-A fixtures record exact symbolic target expressions with frozen bootstrap scalar 0.0. They do not numerically evaluate returns and do not enter Stage B.
frozen_trace_language.continuous_reward_time_schema: A continuous reward measure has no invented scalar occurrence time: physical_support is its exact causal-time interval; the corresponding ordered receipt separately freezes the completion physical time and arrival time.
